hints.title: Small Section Space
hints.text: There are only 12 target sections (0 to 11). For each section, Bob either wins it by shooting aliceArrows[i] + 1 arrows, or scores 0 by shooting 0.

hints.title: Bitmask Enumeration
hints.text: Iterate over all 2^12 = 4096 subsets of sections to determine which sections Bob should win.

hints.title: Residual Arrow Dumping
hints.text: If Bob wins the chosen subset with arrows left over, assign all leftover arrows to section 0.

hints.title: Bitmask Search Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy arrow assignment fails because high-point sections may require disproportionately many arrows.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space since section count is fixed at 12.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies 2^12 small state space and solves via exhaustive bitmask search.
